name: Maybank Visa Infinite Card

percent:local.note: S$1 = 3 TREATS Point 2,900 Points = $10 cash credit, equivalent to 1.03% cashback.

percent:overseas.note: S$1 = 5 TREATS Point 2,900 Points = $10 cash credit, equivalent to 1.72% cashback.

percent:baseline.note: S$1 = 3 TREATS Point 2,900 Points = $10 cash credit, equivalent to 1.03% cashback.

highlights: Earn 2 miles per dollar on overseas purchases, 1.2 miles per dollar on local transactions, insurance, and other eligible spend.
pros: Up to 3X TREATS Points (1.2 mpd) on local spend.
pros: Up to 5X TREATS Points (2 mpd) on foreign currency spend .
pros: Complimentary enrolment into Maybank's Rewards Infinite Programme where TREATS Points never expire.
pros: Dining, shopping, and travel deals via Maybank TREATS SG app.
pros: Up to S$1,000,000 complimentary travel insurance coverage when you charge full travel fare to card.
pros: Unlimited Priority Pass lounge visits per year for primary cardholders.
pros: Complimentary Priority Pass membership renewal upon paying card annual fee or min. S$60,000 in eligible spend in previous card anniversary year.
pros: Complimentary green fees all year round at over 100 golf courses worldwide.
pros: 1x complimentary airport limousine transfer on a Mercedes E-Class with min. S$3,000 eligible spend in previous calendar month.
pros: 1x complimentary JetQuay Service featuring private JetQuay host with min. S$3,000 eligible spend in previous calendar month.
pros: 25% off retail rates for meet-and-greet airport services in selected countries.
pros: 10% off car rentals worldwide with min. 1-day rental (plus 1 extra day rental with min. 6 days' rental).
pros: 24/7 Visa Concierge service and access to Visa Luxury Hotel Collection.
cons: No complimentary airport lounge visits for supplementary cardholders and guests. US$32 per person per visit rate applies.

extra.description: Made for a select few, the Maybank Visa Infinite Card offers exceptional privileges and rewards to cardholders. This premium card allows you to earn 2 miles on foreign spend and 1.2 miles for local spend.
